name: Kled
title: the Cantankerous Cavalier

Q.name: Bear Trap on a Rope
Q.description: Mounted: Kled throws a bear trap that deals 30/55/80/105/130 + 0.6×bonus AD physical damage and hooks onto the first enemy champion or large jungle monster hit. If Kled stays near a hooked enemy for 1.75 seconds, he yanks out the trap, dealing (30/55/80/105/130 + 0.6×bonus AD) × 2 physical damage, Pulling them, and Slowing by 30/35/40/45/50% for 2.5 seconds.
Q.summary: Kled throws a bear trap that damages and hooks an enemy champion. If shackled for a short duration, the target takes additional physical damage and is yanked toward Kled. When dismounted, this ability is replaced by Pocket Pistol, a ranged gun blast that knocks back Kled and restores courage.

W.name: Violent Tendencies
W.description: Passive: Kled's next Attack grants 150% Attack Speed for four Attacks or 4 seconds. The fourth hit deals an additional 20/30/40/50/60 plus (4.5/5/5.5/6/6.5 + 0.02×bonus AD + 0.004×bonus max HP) × 0.01 max Health physical damage.
W.summary: Kled gains massive attack speed for four attacks. The fourth attack deals more damage.

E.name: Jousting
E.description: Kled dashes, dealing 35/60/85/110/135 + 0.55×bonus AD physical damage to enemies he passes through, pulling minions and small monsters towards him. If this Ability hits an enemy champion or large jungle monster, Kled gains 50% Move Speed for 1 second(s) and can Recast within 3 seconds to dash back through the same target.
E.summary: Kled dashes, dealing physical damage and gaining a short burst of speed. Kled can cast this ability again to dash back through his initial target, dealing the same damage.

R.name: Chaaaaaaaarge!!!
R.description: Kled charges toward an area, leaving a trail that grants allies increasing Move Speed. While charging and for 2 seconds after Kled gains up to 200/300/400 + 3×bonus AD Shield. Skaarl rams the first enemy champion encountered, dealing (4/6/8 + 0.03×bonus AD) × 0.01 to (4/6/8 + 0.03×bonus AD) × 0.03 max Health magic damage (based on distance travelled) and briefly Knocking Back.
R.summary: Kled and Skaarl charge to a location, leaving a speed-granting trail behind them and gaining a shield. Skaarl locks onto and rams the first enemy champion encountered.

Passive.name: Skaarl, the Cowardly Lizard
Passive.description: Kled rides his trusty steed, Skaarl, who takes damage for him. When Skaarl's health depletes, Kled dismounts. While dismounted, Kled's abilities change and he deals less damage to champions. Kled can restore Skaarl's courage by fighting enemies. At maximum courage, Kled remounts with a portion of Skaarl's health.
Passive.summary: Kled rides his trusty steed, Skaarl, who takes damage for him. When Skaarl's health depletes, Kled dismounts. While dismounted, Kled's abilities change and he deals less damage to champions. Kled can restore Skaarl's courage by fighting enemies. At maximum courage, Kled remounts with a portion of Skaarl's health.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Kled is a fighter who rides Skaarl, a lizard with her own health bar, and dismounts when she runs out. He plays top, hooks enemies with Bear Trap on a Rope, and starts fights with Chaaaaaaaarge!!!.
strengths: Skaarl is a second health bar, so he survives more damage than it looks.
Bear Trap on a Rope hooks and pulls, a strong engage.
Jousting dashes through enemies and can be recast to dash back.
Chaaaaaaaarge!!! leads his team into a fight with move speed and a shield.
weaknesses: Q yank needs him to stay near the hooked target.
Falls off late against tanky teams.

curve.lvl1: strong – mounted all-in with Skaarl's health bar beats most top laners
curve.lvl2: strong – Q hook then yank drags the target into him
curve.lvl3: strong – E dash and recast completes the all-in
curve.lvl6: very strong – Chaaaaaaaarge!!! starts fights from far away with a shield
curve.items: medium – first item: Black Cleaver, Sundered Sky or Eclipse

profile.curveNote: Kled is strong from level 1 and wants to all-in early.
profile.mobility: Good: E dash and R charge.

keyAbilities.answers: None. Kled has no spell shield or dodge.

Passive.notes: Skaarl, the Cowardly Lizard: Skaarl takes damage for him; Kled dismounts when she runs out and remounts with courage.

Q.answer: Dodge sideways, or block with a projectile block; walk away from Kled before the yank.
Q.notes: Bear Trap on a Rope: hooks the first champion hit; if he stays close, yanks (pulls) and slows.

W.answer: Jax E dodges; Fiora W parries.
W.notes: Violent Tendencies: next attack grants attack speed; fourth hit deals % max HP damage.

E.notes: Jousting: a dash, recastable through the same target.

R.notes: Chaaaaaaaarge!!!: a long charge that gives a shield and knocks back the first champion.

profile.windowAgainst: Kled's window is when he is dismounted: he is much weaker until Skaarl returns.
checks: Does Kled hook before going in?
